title: Public handle, first-login handle picker and reader profile
description:
As a reader, I want a public handle I choose once, so that my activity is attributed without exposing my email address.

Open policy decisions to settle in this story and record on it: handle format and uniqueness, minimum account age before voting, whether editors act under their own handles, handle changes. The email address is never published or stored in public records.

```gherkin
Feature: Reader handle
  Scenario: First login
    Given a newly signed-in reader without a handle
    When the reader opens any interactive control
    Then a handle picker is shown first
    And the chosen handle must be unique within the publication

  Scenario: Handle is public, email is not
    When a reader's vote or submission is displayed
    Then only the handle appears
    And no email address appears in any public JSON or page
```

comments.text: Reconciliation 2026-10-22. Duplicate of PPY-a811b3 (closed), which covered the handle API and profile (Papyrus #512: POST /api/reader/handle, unique case-insensitive handle claim, reserved handles, public readerId). The first-login handle picker is the ReaderSignIn island from #516 (docs/reader-steering.md), and the no-email rule is enforced by the privacy scan (#516). Handle history is kept here; PPY-a811b3 survives.
